description: Fuzzy-screen a name against OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, Swiss SECO, World Bank debarment and US BIS/State/Treasury non-SDN lists (optional lists= filter): matches with list, id, primary name, matched alias, score, type, programs, countries, dates of birth, listing date and reference, plus the date each list was checked. Price: $0.008 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.

birthYear.description: Optional 4-digit birth year (individuals); boosts entries within 1 year, demotes clear mismatches

country.description: Optional country name or ISO2 code; boosts entries linked to that country

lists.description: Optional comma list to restrict: ofac, un, eu, uk, seco, worldbank, bis, us_csl (default all)

name.description: Person, company or vessel name (any script; accents and legal suffixes are ignored)

type.description: Optional filter: individual, entity or vessel

name: sanctions_screen
